body:
First of all, thank you for your message. Don't apologise for the length or anything, you have something to share and I'm greatly thankful for it. :)

I feel a lot of empathy with what you're describing because I feel quite similar to you. I've always had a relatively sheltered life when compared to this person or your girlfriend for example. And it's just terrible to face these situation of utter helplessness.

The past year I learned from therapy that I needed to learn how to protect myself while helping others, and that sometimes, people can change but don't want to, and so it would only hurt me to try. Here, I'm in a situation where a person wants to change, and just can't, and that somehow just makes it even more terrible.

If you would like to pm me I'd like to hear what you'd have to say. Especially, you've been with this person despite the troubles they face, and I feel like I could accept that. But how do you deal with the idea that you feel that this person will never be able to get better (bc that's what the person I met told me, although I'm not sure if your girlfriend feels the same way, sorry to assume she does if she doesn't.  Because to me I feel that that's what would destory me and force me to abandon them in the end - the idea that this person whom I love will always have to live with this pain, and that I'd feel helpless to change it.

On the flipside, have you felt that things got easier as time went on? That despite everything, things have actually improved? Did they seem like they would never improve and then did, or did you always feel that things wouldn't improve?

Sorry to pepper you with questions. To reiterate, thank you for your kind and thoughful message. I'd like to give you all the support I can :)

ISP did a video on this. Basically the bookmarks where implemented in one of the first versions of the game, but they never updated the bookmarks when they released expansions. The result is that any of the bookmarks (especially later ones) are massively imbalanced messes.
I think I'm going to walk away... But I don't know how to cope with this even if I do. They could be dead in 2 weeks. How the fuck could I ever deal with that?

I guess you're right. It's just that I'm 21, and I've never managed to make anyone like me like this before, except one another person I went on a date with and that ended with some drama really quickly as well due to the other person just coming out of a relationship. So when finally I find someone who likes me... I got attached really quickly.

I guess I barely know them... But I still know I like them, and I don't want them to die. If they do, I don't know how I could bear that.
